page: City page: B2B lead generation Ahmedabad (/b2b-lead-generation-ahmedabad)

items.question: Do we need to be based in Ahmedabad to work with you?
items.answer: No. The entire engagement runs remotely from our office in BKC, Mumbai, so it doesn't matter where in Gujarat, or beyond, your team is based. Strategy calls, sequence approvals and weekly reporting all happen over video calls and a shared dashboard, the same way they do for every client.

items.question: Do you only work with Ahmedabad or Gujarat companies?
items.answer: No. We have clients in Ahmedabad and across Gujarat, but we run outbound systems for B2B and export-focused companies across India and internationally, 130+ so far. For exporters, that includes campaigns to buyers in Europe, the Middle East and Southeast Asia, with copy and send timing adapted to each market.

items.question: How quickly can we expect meetings to start?
items.answer: Campaigns go live within 18 days of kickoff, and most clients see their first qualified conversations in weeks 3 to 4. The first two weeks go into ICP mapping, list building, sending domains with warm-up, and copy. Meeting volume usually becomes consistent by weeks 6 to 8, once messaging is tuned on real replies.

items.question: What does pricing look like?
items.answer: We work on a monthly retainer with a 3-month minimum, which covers setup and enough sending to judge results. After that it runs month to month with 30 days' notice, with no annual contract. We don't publish a price list; we share a quote after a free GTM audit call, once we know which channels you need.

items.question: Which Ahmedabad and Gujarat industries do you have the most experience with?
items.answer: Textile, pharmaceutical and chemical manufacturers and exporters are where we've run the most campaigns. Examples include a ₹48 lakh pipeline for a contract pharma manufacturer and 15 buyer opportunities for a textile exporter. The system adapts to any B2B ICP, so if you sell to other businesses from Gujarat, it applies.

items.question: What channels do you actually use to generate leads?
items.answer: Primarily cold email and LinkedIn outreach aimed at reaching international buyers, importers, and procurement teams, layered with account-based marketing for named target accounts, and AI-assisted list building and personalisation underneath all three. We pick the mix based on where your buyers, whether a distributor in the Gulf or a procurement team in Europe, actually spend their attention.

items.question: How is this different from hiring an in-house SDR?
items.answer: Hiring an in-house SDR in Ahmedabad means months of recruiting and ramp-up before they're fully productive, and even then, one person can only run so many sequences at once. A managed outbound system has multiple channels live within about three weeks, at a fraction of the fully loaded cost of a hire, and scales without you managing headcount.

items.question: What do you need from us to get started?
items.answer: A clear picture of your ICP (even a rough one works), access to a domain we can set up for outbound sending, and about an hour of your time for an onboarding call. We handle ICP refinement, list building, sequence writing, and day-to-day campaign management from there.
